question: In Head and Neck Phase 3 trials, standardize the primary endpoint into one of OS, PFS, ORR, DFS, DOR, AE-rate, or Other.

steps.desc: Filter Head and Neck Phase 3 trials and select primary endpoint text.
Map free text to controlled primary endpoint categories.
steps.prompt: For each row, read Primary endpoint and emit JSON {NCT, PMID, primary_endpoint_type} with label in ["OS","PFS","ORR","DFS","DOR","AE-rate","Other","unknown"]. Heuristics: OS if overall survival dominates; PFS if progression free survival dominates; ORR if objective response rate; DFS if disease free survival; DOR if duration of response; AE-rate if adverse event rate; Other if none of above; unknown if can't tell. Output JSON objects only—one per input row; no prose.

steps.desc: Validate label set and drop invalid rows.
